meanings.usage: 强调快速、贪婪地吃掉某物，也可引申指自然灾害等彻底毁坏事物
特指羊的群体，也可指代鸟群或人群
多指牛、马等大型家畜的群体
强调只占整体的很小一部分
用于补充说明，递进逻辑连接词，比furthermore更正式
复数名词，指个人的随身物品或私有财产
常与介词to搭配，表示“与…相关/有亲缘关系”
指针对某一范围内的对象进行的全面统计调查
指根据现有信息进行大致的推算，名词形式为/ˈestɪmət/

meanings.meaning: 英亩(面积单位，约等于4047平方米)
meanings.usage: 计量土地面积的英制单位

phrases.usage: 表示“把…归功于；欠…某物”，用于说明功劳、成果的来源

examples.en: We owe a lot to the birds and beasts who eat insects.
examples.zh: 我们十分感激那些捕食昆虫的鸟类和兽类。

examples.en: I owe my success to my family's support.
examples.zh: 我把我的成功归功于家人的支持。

phrases.usage: 表示“加起来；总共”，常用于对比某一群体和其他群体总和的差距

examples.en: All of them put together kill only a fraction of the number destroyed by spiders.
examples.zh: 把它们所有加起来，杀死的昆虫数量也只是蜘蛛消灭数量的一小部分。

examples.en: The profit of this month is more than the profit of the past three months put together.
examples.zh: 这个月的利润比过去三个月的总和还多。

phrases.usage: 表示“对…造成伤害/损害”，harm前可加little/any/the least等修饰词

examples.en: Spiders never do the least harm to us or our belongings.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛从不对我们或我们的财物造成丝毫损害。

examples.en: Smoking does great harm to people's lungs.
examples.zh: 吸烟对人的肺部有很大伤害。

phrases.usage: 表示“一眼；一看就”，强调识别、判断的速度非常快

examples.en: One can tell the difference almost at a glance.
examples.zh: 人们几乎一眼就能看出两者的区别。

examples.en: He recognized his old friend at a glance in the crowd.
examples.zh: 他在人群里一眼就认出了自己的老朋友。

phrases.usage: 表示“忙于；从事于”，侧重指正在参与或忙于某项长期固定的活动

examples.en: How many spiders are engaged in this work on our behalf?
examples.zh: 有多少蜘蛛在为我们做这项工作呢？

examples.en: He has been engaged in environmental protection for 10 years.
examples.zh: 他从事环保工作已经10年了。

phrases.usage: 表示“代表某人；为了某人的利益”，也可写作on behalf of sb

examples.en: Lawyers can make statements on their clients' behalf.
examples.zh: 律师可以代表客户发表声明。

grammar.title: 虚拟条件句（与现在事实相反）
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 动词过去式（be动词统一用were）, 主语 + would/could/might + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 用来描述与现在真实情况不符的假设，表达不可能实现或假想的情况 用于表达非真实的假设，说明假设情况下会产生的结果

examples.en: If it were not for the protection we get from insect eating animals, they would devour all our crops and kill our flocks and herds.
examples.zh: 若不是我们从食虫动物那里得到保护，它们就会吃光我们所有的庄稼，杀死我们的牛羊。

examples.en: If I were you, I would choose to study abroad.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会选择出国留学。

grammar.title: as引导的非限制性定语从句（否定转移）
grammar.structure: 主语 + 否定谓语 + ..., as + 从句
grammar.definition: as指代整个主句的内容，放在否定句中时，否定含义通常转移到as指代的内容上，表示“正如…不是那样” 用于纠正大众的错误认知，说明“某件事并不像人们所想的那样”

examples.en: Spiders are not insects, as many people think, nor even nearly related to them.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛并不像很多人认为的那样是昆虫，它们甚至和昆虫完全没有亲缘关系。

examples.en: The elephant is not as big as you imagine.
examples.zh: 大象并不像你想象的那么大。

patterns.pattern: Why, you may wonder, should + 主语 + be + 表语?

original.en: Why, you may wonder, should spiders be our friends?
original.zh: 你可能会好奇，为什么蜘蛛应该是我们的朋友呢？

imitations.en: Why, you may wonder, should trees be so important to cities?
imitations.zh: 你可能会好奇，为什么树木对城市这么重要呢？

imitations.en: Why, you may wonder, should learning history be necessary for students?
imitations.zh: 你可能会好奇，为什么学习历史对学生来说是必要的？

patterns.pattern: It is impossible to do sth, but + 补充说明的分句

original.en: It is impossible to make more than the wildest guess at how many they kill, but they are hungry creatures, not content with only three meals a day.
original.zh: 我们最多只能胡乱猜测它们杀死了多少昆虫，但它们是贪吃的生物，并不满足于一天只吃三餐。

imitations.en: It is impossible to count how many stars are in the sky, but we know there are far more than we can see.
imitations.zh: 我们不可能数清天上有多少星星，但我们知道星星的数量远多于我们能看到的。

imitations.en: It is impossible to remember all the new words in one day, but we can memorize them step by step.
imitations.zh: 我们不可能一天记住所有的新单词，但我们可以一步步记住它们。

patterns.pattern: It has been estimated that + 从句

original.en: It has been estimated that the weight of all the insects destroyed by spiders in Britain in one year would be greater than the total weight of all the human beings in the country.
original.zh: 据估计，英国境内的蜘蛛一年消灭的所有昆虫的总重量，比这个国家所有人口的总重量还要大。

imitations.en: It has been estimated that over 50% of the city's population will choose public transport in 5 years.
imitations.zh: 据估计，五年内这个城市超过50%的人口会选择公共交通。

imitations.en: It has been estimated that the global temperature will rise by 1.5 degrees by 2050 if we don't reduce carbon emissions.
imitations.zh: 据估计，如果我们不减少碳排放，到2050年全球气温将上升1.5度。

lines.en: killing insects? Why, you may wonder, should spiders be our friends?
lines.zh: 你可能会觉得奇怪，蜘蛛怎么会是我们的朋友呢？

lines.en: Because they destroy so many insects, and insects include some of the greatest enemies of the human race.
lines.zh: 因为它们能消灭那么多的昆虫，其中包括一些人类的大敌，要不是人类受一些食虫动物的保护，昆虫就会使我们无法在地球上生活下去，昆虫会吞食我们的全部庄稼，杀死我们的成群的牛羊。

lines.en: Insects would make it impossible for us to live in the world; they would devour all our crops and kill our flocks and herds , if it were not for the protection we get from insect-eating animals.
lines.zh: 我们要十分感谢那些吃昆虫的鸟和兽，然而把它们所杀死的昆虫全部加在一起也只相当于蜘蛛所消灭的一小部分。

lines.en: We owe a lot to the birds and beasts who eat insects but all of them put together kill only a fraction of the number destroyed by spiders.
lines.zh: 此外，蜘蛛不同于其他食虫动物，它们丝毫不危害我们和我们的财物。

lines.en: Moreover, unlike some of the other insect eaters, spiders never do the harm to us or our belongings Spiders are not insects, as many people think, nor even nearly related to them.
lines.zh: 许多人认为蜘蛛是昆虫，但它们不是昆虫，甚至与昆虫毫无关系。

lines.en: One can tell the difference almost at a glance, for a spider always has eight legs and insect never more than six.
lines.zh: 人们几乎一眼就能看出二者的差异，因为蜘蛛都是8条腿，而昆虫的腿从不超过6条。

lines.en: How many spiders are engaged in this work no our behalf?
lines.zh: 有多少蜘蛛在为我们效力呢？

lines.en: One authority on spiders made a census of the spiders in grass field in the south of England, and he estimated that there were more than 2,250,000 in one acre; that is something like 6,000,000 spiders of different kinds on a football pitch.
lines.zh: 一位研究蜘蛛的权威对英国南部一块草坪上的蜘蛛作了一次调查。

lines.en: Spiders are busy for at least half the year in killing insects.
lines.zh: 他估计每英亩草坪里有225万多只蜘蛛。

lines.en: It is impossible to make more than the wildest guess at how many they kill, but they are hungry creatures, not content with only three meals a day.
lines.zh: 这就是说，在一个足球场上约有600万只不同种类的蜘蛛。

lines.en: It has been estimated that the weight of all the insects destroyed by spiders in Britain in one year would be greater than the total weight of all the human beings in the country.
lines.zh: 蜘蛛至少有半年在忙于吃昆虫。
它们一年中消灭了多少昆虫，我们简直无法猜测，它们是吃不饱的动物，不满意一日三餐。
据估计，在英国蜘蛛一年里所消灭昆虫的重量超过这个国家人口的总重量。

questions.q: How much of each year do spiders spend killing insects?
questions.zh: 蜘蛛一年中有多少时间在消灭昆虫？
questions.hint: 见课文 Spiders are busy for at least half the year in killing insects.

questions.q: Why should spiders be our friends?
questions.zh: 为什么蜘蛛应当是我们的朋友？
questions.a: Because they destroy so many insects, and insects include some of the greatest enemies of the human race.
questions.aZh: 因为它们消灭那么多昆虫，而昆虫中包括一些人类最大的敌人。
questions.hint: 见课文开头 Because they destroy so many insects…

questions.q: How can one tell a spider from an insect?
questions.zh: 怎样一眼看出蜘蛛和昆虫的差别？
questions.a: A spider always has eight legs and an insect never more than six.
questions.aZh: 蜘蛛总是有八条腿，而昆虫的腿从不超过六条。
questions.hint: 见课文 One can tell the difference almost at a glance…

questions.q: What did the authority on spiders estimate in the south of England?
questions.zh: 那位蜘蛛研究权威在英国南部估计出了什么？
questions.a: He estimated that there were more than 2,250,000 spiders in one acre, that is about 6,000,000 of different kinds on a football pitch.
questions.aZh: 他估计每英亩有225万多只蜘蛛，也就是说一个足球场上约有600万只不同种类的蜘蛛。
questions.hint: 见课文 made a census… and he estimated that…

questions.q: Why does the author say the insects destroyed by spiders in Britain in one year would weigh more than all the people in the country?
questions.zh: 作者为什么说英国蜘蛛一年消灭的昆虫重量超过全国人口的总重量？
questions.a: To show how enormous the spiders' work is, so that we should spare them instead of killing them.
questions.aZh: 为了说明蜘蛛灭虫的功劳之大，我们应当保护它们而不是伤害它们。
questions.hint: 结合作者写作目的与课文结尾的估计数据思考。

translation:
你可能会觉得奇怪，蜘蛛怎么会是我们的朋友呢？
因为它们能消灭那么多的昆虫，其中包括一些人类的大敌，要不是人类受一些食虫动物的保护，昆虫就会使我们无法在地球上生活下去，昆虫会吞食我们的全部庄稼，杀死我们的成群的牛羊。
我们要十分感谢那些吃昆虫的鸟和兽，然而把它们所杀死的昆虫全部加在一起也只相当于蜘蛛所消灭的一小部分。
此外，蜘蛛不同于其他食虫动物，它们丝毫不危害我们和我们的财物。
许多人认为蜘蛛是昆虫，但它们不是昆虫，甚至与昆虫毫无关系。
人们几乎一眼就能看出二者的差异，因为蜘蛛都是8条腿，而昆虫的腿从不超过6条。
有多少蜘蛛在为我们效力呢？
一位研究蜘蛛的权威对英国南部一块草坪上的蜘蛛作了一次调查。
他估计每英亩草坪里有225万多只蜘蛛。
这就是说，在一个足球场上约有600万只不同种类的蜘蛛。
蜘蛛至少有半年在忙于吃昆虫。
它们一年中消灭了多少昆虫，我们简直无法猜测，它们是吃不饱的动物，不满意一日三餐。
据估计，在英国蜘蛛一年里所消灭昆虫的重量超过这个国家人口的总重量。

title: Spare That Spider
subtitle: 别伤害蜘蛛

lead.question: 蜘蛛令人厌恶，作者却称它们是朋友，一年中它们有多少时间在消灭昆虫？
lead.warmup: 提起蜘蛛，许多人第一反应是厌恶甚至害怕，恨不得立刻拍死。但这篇选自《听众》的文章却大声呼吁：别伤害蜘蛛。作者用一组惊人的数据说明，蜘蛛一年中至少有一半时间在消灭昆虫，功劳远超鸟类和野兽；它们不是昆虫，从不伤害我们与我们财物。读完你就会明白，这个不起眼的小生物，其实是庄稼与牛羊的守护者。
goals: 掌握 spider, insect, devour, estimate, acre, census 等本课核心词汇。
理解并会分析 why, you may wonder 这类插入语及疑问句结构。
学会用现在完成时与被动语态客观陈述调查、估计等事实。
能用比较级表达蜘蛛与其他食虫动物在灭虫数量上的差异。
lead.summary: 本文选自《听众》杂志。作者指出蜘蛛是我们的朋友：它们消灭大量昆虫，而昆虫是人类的大敌。与鸟兽相比，蜘蛛消灭的昆虫多得多，且从不伤害我们和我们的财物。蜘蛛不是昆虫，它有八条腿，昆虫至多六条。一位蜘蛛权威调查发现，每英亩草地竟有二百多万只蜘蛛，它们一年至少半年忙于灭虫，所消灭昆虫的总重量超过全英国人的体重。
lead.tips: why, you may wonder 是插入语，去掉后句子结构才清楚：You may wonder why spiders should be our friends? 写作时插入语两侧要用逗号隔开，切勿与主句混为一谈。

exercises.q: 汉译英：昆虫会吞食我们全部的庄稼，杀死我们成群的牛羊。
exercises.a: Insects would devour all our crops and kill our flocks and herds.
exercises.note: devour 指狼吞虎咽地吞食。

exercises.q: 汉译英：要不是有食虫动物的保护，昆虫就会使我们无法在地球上生活下去。
exercises.a: If it were not for the protection we get from insect-eating animals, insects would make it impossible for us to live in the world.
exercises.note: if it were not for 为虚拟语气。

exercises.q: 句型转换：They have destroyed a large number of insects.（改为被动语态）
exercises.a: A large number of insects have been destroyed by them.
exercises.note: 现在完成时的被动为 have been done。

exercises.q: 填空：One authority on spiders made a ____ of them and ____ that there were more than 2,250,000 in one ____.
改错：Spiders are not insects, nor even nearly related with them.
exercises.a: related to them（related to 为固定搭配，不用 with）
exercises.note: be related to 表示与……有关。

exercises.q: 汉译英：与鸟兽相比，蜘蛛消灭的昆虫要多得多。
exercises.a: Spiders destroy far more insects than birds and beasts do.
exercises.note: 比较级 far more…than 差异明显。

exercises.q: 填空：It ____ been estimated that the weight of all the insects destroyed by spiders in Britain in one year ____ be greater than that of all the human beings.
exercises.note: It has been estimated 意为据估计。

quiz.q: 蜘蛛一年中至少有多长时间在消灭昆虫？
quiz.note: at least half the year 至少半年。

quiz.q: 蜘蛛与昆虫最关键的区别是什么？
options: A spider has eight legs while an insect has no more than six.
Spiders have wings but insects do not.
Spiders live only in grass fields.

quiz.q: 作者认为哪一类动物消灭的昆虫最多？
一位权威对英国南部草地蜘蛛数量的估计是？
options: Fewer than 1,000 on a football pitch.

quiz.q: 文中 devour 的意思最接近？
作者写这篇文章的主要目的是什么？
options: To teach readers how to keep spiders as pets.
To persuade us not to harm spiders.
To explain how a census is done.
To compare British and foreign spiders.
